run_conditional_command: run a shell command only when condition is true and all needed names are present in have names
test_conditional_execution: test the if.py module with --cond true and matching --need and --have arguments to execute a command
build_conditional_runner: build a conditional command runner that checks --cond, --need, and --have before executing the command
review_conditional_logic: review the if.py module conditional logic that checks condition and set subset before running shell command
summarize_if_module: summarize the if.py CLI module that conditionally executes shell commands based on need/have attribute matching
